summary: ## What & why The Esteban prospect **seeker** was blocked on a "missing" Google Maps API key. Investigation found two things: 1. **The seeker never used Google Maps at all** — `daily-google-maps-prospect-scanner.mjs` looped a hardcoded, partly-fake list (`info@…example`, `(954) 555-0182`). Zero `GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY` references in the repo. 2. The key itself is a **Vercel *sensitive* env var** — write-only, unreadable by API/CLI/dashboard for anyone. So chasing it was a dead end regardless. So instead of the key, the seeker now discovers **real** local businesses with a **keyless** source. ##
